annotations.title: Market-wide insider buying and cluster buys

description: Recent open-market insider purchases (Form 4 code P) across all U.S. public companies, grouped by issuer and ranked by number of buying insiders, then dollar value. A "cluster buy" is 2+ insiders buying the same stock. Filter by look-back days, minimum total value, minimum insiders and role. Data is built from a rolling scan of recent EDGAR Form 4 filings (coverage starts at deployment, up to 30 days).

min_insiders.description: Minimum distinct buying insiders per issuer; use 2 for cluster buys only. Default 1.

min_value.description: Minimum total purchase value per issuer in USD, e.g. 100000.

role.description: Only purchases by officers, directors or 10% owners.
